title: FrameOS group integrity on member delete (dangling refs + stale group box)
defect: removeNode filtered only nodes/edges; groups[].memberIds kept referencing deleted nodes and the group box was never recomputed, so the group overlay kept stale geometry and arrange/drag/ungroup operated on a wrong member set.
fix: added reconcileGroups(groups, nodes): prune dangling members, recompute the member bbox + 28 padding, drop groups whose members are all gone, and clear selectedGroupId when its group disappears
